ipeds_ef.title: IPEDS Fall Enrollment 2023 (EF2023A): undergraduate total and U.S. nonresident headcount

stats.notes: CDS 2023-24 C1 (fall 2023 entering class; newest CDS Rutgers has posted for Newark, no 2024-25 or 2025-26 edition found). International: 2,211 applied, 1,550 admitted (70%), 29 enrolled. SAT/ACT percentiles and GPA (C9, C11, C12) are blank in the CDS; no waitlist policy; no early decision. College Navigator (IPEDS fall 2024) shows 36,793 applicants and 71% admitted, a much larger applicant count than the CDS, so the CDS figures are used here. Enrollment (7,989 undergraduates) and student-faculty ratio (14:1) are College Navigator fall 2024; the CDS has 7,417 and 13:1 for fall 2023.

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8A: SAT/ACT not used in admission decisions; C8F: reviews of applicants for regular admission are test blind.

cost.notes: CDS G1 (AY 2024-25): in-state tuition $14,222, out-of-state $33,734, required fees $3,028 (College Navigator shows the same, $36,762 out-of-state with fees). Room and board, books and total are College Navigator 2024-25 on-campus figures (total is the out-of-state on-campus cost; in-state $39,200); the CDS food-and-housing line reads $16,074. CDS H6: only institutional non-need-based aid is available to nonresidents; 31 nonresidents received it (average $7,467).
